Bug_Title: BIT: Bitwise OR of signed byte value (BIT_IOR_OF_SIGNED_BYTE)
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the line where the bitwise OR operation is performed on a byte value. Since byte values are sign extended to 32 bits before any bitwise operations, the code can result in an unexpected value if the byte value is negative.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered when a byte array containing only negative values is passed to the showBug method. The bitwise OR operation on a signed byte value leads to an unexpected result due to sign extension.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results confirm the presence of the bug. The test case uses an array of bytes where each byte is 0xff. According to the bug information, this will cause the bitwise OR operation to sign extend 0xff to 0xffffffff, resulting in an incorrect final value of -1 instead of the expected 4294967295.
